Carney targets trade and defence in Türkiye as Ottawa boosts tech and procurement. 🇨🇦

### Aerospace & Defence
Prime Minister Mark Carney's official visit to Ankara and Istanbul lays the groundwork for a comprehensive Canada-Türkiye free trade agreement, boosting two-way merchandise trade past $4.3 billion and focusing heavily on bilateral commercial ventures. The engagement targets advanced technologies, aerospace, mining, critical minerals, and defence sector co-production, unlocking high-value export pathways for Canadian contractors. Position your firm to engage participating trade delegates and commercial missions by offering specialized market-entry advisory and joint-venture structuring services tailored to the Canada-Türkiye economic corridor. Department of National Defence digital infrastructure investments require robust, high-performance computing capabilities to support complex computational workloads and defense research. The technological target involves ASUS Ascent Supercomputers, enterprise-grade server hardware, and high-density server storage devices. Position your firm as an enterprise hardware integrator or specialized IT reseller capable of delivering high-performance computing clusters and secure storage systems to DND.

### Artificial Intelligence & Technology
The Prime Minister’s launch of the National Council on Artificial Intelligence operationalizes the federal AI for All strategy, prioritizing domestic AI capabilities, sovereign compute infrastructure, and public sector adoption. The technological roadmap mandates sovereign AI compute stacks, national foundation model safety benchmarking, secure enterprise data governance frameworks, and Canadian-resident infrastructure architecture. Advise public sector departments and Crown corporations on sovereign AI compliance, domestic data residency verification, and secure enterprise model implementation in alignment with the Council's emerging guidelines.

### Clean Energy & Infrastructure
Environment and Climate Change Canada announced the 2026 ENERGY STAR Award recipients, highlighting leaders across fenestration products, HVAC, manufacturing, commercial buildings, and utility efficiency programs, building on the 25th anniversary of the initiative. The initiative aligns with the national electricity strategy and federal decarbonization targets, accelerating the adoption of high-efficiency hardware, smart building automation, and low-carbon tech standards. Reach out to recognized municipal, healthcare, and educational building winners to pitch energy-audit consulting, ESG reporting software stacks, and IoT-enabled HVAC optimization retrofits.

### International Trade & Supply Chain
Global Affairs Canada is expanding trade diversification efforts across G20 partners, specifically engaging Saudi Arabia, the EU, and India to counter supply chain vulnerability and steel excess capacity during the G20 Trade Ministers' summit in Milwaukee. The operational emphasis targets international digital trade corridors, critical minerals traceability systems, steel production verification protocols, and export supply chain transparency tools. Position supply chain consulting and export advisory services to assist Canadian industrial and clean-tech firms in securing export channels under bilateral commercial agreements.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/
#TradePolicy #ArtificialIntelligence #EnergyEfficiency #DefenceTech #SupplyChain
